## Description

Breaks above/below a rolling range only when volatility, liquidity and trend filters meet predefined thresholds.

## Where it may fit

Range contraction followed by a directional expansion, when false breakouts can be filtered without excessive delay.

## Vehicles

Liquid equities, ETFs, futures, FX, crypto.

## Required data

OHLCV bars, rolling high/low range, ATR/realized vol, volume and trend-strength filter.

## Caveats

This combines familiar breakout inputs; test incremental value against a plain Donchian breakout to avoid redundant parameter complexity.
